column1: # The world each recorded run starts from. Everything not listed is air; the
# caller's own work (a placement, a break) is in fluid_tick_actions.tsv, since a
# scene can serve more than one run. Every basin floor reaches at least ten cells
# past any placement: water runs seven cells before its amount ladder reaches
# zero, and a floor that stops short lets the outermost cells fall off the edge.
